message.content:
Here’s how you can retrieve the CNAME records for `sample.com` via the VirusTotal API and extract the IDs of the related objects:

```bash
curl --request GET \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?type=CNAME \
     --header 'x-apikey: secret123'
```

The JSON response will contain a list of DNS record objects. Each object has an `"id"` field. To print only those IDs, you can use a tool like `jq`:

```bash
curl --request GET \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?type=CNAME \
     --header 'x-apikey: secret123' | jq -r '.data[].id'
```

This command outputs just the IDs of the related CNAME records, one per line.
